name: Photographe de Teyvat/13.04.2023
description: Ruins of ancient kingdoms, fantastical seas of flowers, and the deepest reaches of vast deserts. It's time for another expedition to the desert, exploring that stunning landscape and seeing the magnificent creatures there...<hr />Olah! Hello, Travelers~ A new area of the desert region of Sumeru City is now open, and it's time to go explore it and take photos to commemorate the occasion! Share photos you take in the new region during the event to win cool merchandise!
